rules: All execution timestamps must be timezone-aware and inside the approved authorization window.
Only physical, non-emulator environments are accepted.
Every referenced evidence file must exist beside the bundle and match its SHA-256 digest.
Sample IDs and correlation IDs must be unique across the bundle.
Private keys, bearer credentials and inline secret assignments are rejected.
Mock, synthetic, template, dry-run and local-only evidence classes cannot pass.
The matrix must cover every declared Android x LAMDA x App N/N-1 cell exactly once.
Stable and candidate tracks must both meet the minimum real sample count.
Candidate soak duration must be at least 72 hours.
Candidate failure and regression rates must remain within declared thresholds.
Safety violations and unknown commits must be zero.
Every cell requires a tested passing rollback before PROMOTE can be approved.
Each pair must compare AUTOJS and CLOUDCTL using the same authorized scenario and input digest.
Candidate failure, outcome regression and p95 duration regression must meet policy thresholds.
Safety violations and unknown commits must be zero.
A tested passing rollback and a reviewed MIGRATE decision are required.
The validator never executes or packages AutoJS; it only reads external results.
Selected canary devices must be unique and cannot exceed 5 percent of the eligible population.
The declared percentage must equal selectedCount / eligiblePopulation.
Minimum sample and observation-duration thresholds must be met.
Failure and stable-regression thresholds must be met.
Safety violations, unknown commits, duplicate irreversible actions and audit gaps must be zero.
Irreversible actions must bind to the release commitIntentId.
A tested rollback and completed postmortem/release review are required.
